audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 4 were 'Skill' and row 6 was 'Kled', while whys[3] and whys[4] are Kled-positive and whys[6] plus spikes[3] both say Trundle out-scales past two items. The header also disagreed with itself: diff FAV, the even-matchup colour, 6/10, and report[14] reading 'Even matchup' on a lane that wins 55.94%.
audit.why: The mirror (trundle__kled) moved Trundle's own page to HARD at 7/10, so the inverse belongs here: a favoured lane whose one losing stage is the two-item drain-tank window.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 -> Kled (7/10), row 6 -> Trundle (4/10) as paired full+content rows, matching the packet chart. diffRating -> 4/10 with the favoured tone, and the two prose fields quoting the number updated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kled's Bear Trap was credited with percent-HP damage in six fields, and Frozen Domain's real spike was never dated.
audit.why: Kled Q has no percentHealth flag — the percent-health damage in this lane is Trundle's (King's Tribute heals a percent of a dying unit's max health; Subjugate steals a percent of yours). Frozen Domain is 18s at rank 1 and raises healing from ALL sources while he stands on it, which is the actual reason his sustain 'ramps'.
audit.corrected: Percent-HP claims removed from whys[2], whys[3], whys[5], spikes[0], spikes[2], mid and wants.you[1]; Frozen Domain named as the timing that closes your window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was absent: Pillar of Ice denies Kled's mobility.
audit.why: Pillar of Ice creates IMPASSABLE TERRAIN (21s at rank 1, 1000 range). A pillar dropped in your path cancels Jousting and cancels Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! — both of your commitment tools — so the dash must be held until the pillar is spent, not spent into it. The old text only warned about its slow. The mirror states the same thing from Trundle's side, so both pages now agree.
audit.corrected: Stated in mid, wants.foe[2], report[5], dontsFull[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chomp was treated as poke rather than as a reset, and the packet flags 'Pillar of Filth' as a wrong name.
audit.why: Chomp is an auto-attack RESET on 3.5s at 300 range, so the wind-up of his attack is the tell, not the ability cast. And the ability is Pillar of Ice.
audit.corrected: Name fixed in mid; the 3.5s reset behaviour added to early, mid and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: The anti-heal and resistances-invalidated interactions never reached the prose.
audit.why: King's Tribute heals him off every dying unit, Frozen Domain multiplies that healing, and Subjugate steals a percent of your health AND both resistances, doubled over four seconds — so buying armour or MR against him actively feeds his ultimate.
audit.corrected: Both added to late, dosFull[2] and dosFull[0].

edits.before: Trundle's level 1 is annoying — his Q (Chomp) bites a chunk of your attack damage and slows you, so don't walk up to throw a Bear Trap into a Q he can just sap. Preserve Skaarl's mount health and farm until level 2. Then it's yours: your W on-hit shots and the level-3 E-W-E re-E combo with the percent-HP Q out-trade a Trundle who has no burst answer yet — yank in, dump the Jousting Procs, and remount off the damage before his W zone and Pillar can peel you.
edits.after: Trundle's level 1 is annoying — Chomp bites a chunk of your attack damage and slows you on a 3.5-second cooldown, and it resets his attack, so the wind-up is the tell. Preserve Skaarl's mount health and farm to level 2. Then it's yours: Violent Tendencies and the level-3 E-W-E re-E out-trade a Trundle with no burst answer yet — yank in, dump all four attacks, and remount off the damage before Frozen Domain and Pillar of Ice peel you off.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 stay yours as long as you respect the Q-bite. Stack Violent Tendencies shots and trade with remount sustain — your percent-HP Q shreds his drain-tank HP faster than his Chomp-reduced autos hurt you. Watch his E (Pillar of Filth) — he plants it to slow you and reset the trade in his favor, so don't path through it on your yank. At 6, Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! is the difference-maker: knock him into terrain or your tower so his W move-speed zone can't kite you out of the all-in, and his R can't save him if he's already dead.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 stay yours as long as you respect the Q-bite. Stack Violent Tendencies attacks and trade with remount sustain — Chomp is 3.5s and saps your AD, so trade in short bursts, not grinds. The real threat is Pillar of Ice: it is impassable terrain, so a well-placed pillar cancels your Jousting dash AND your Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! outright, and it is 21s at rank 1 — hold the dash until he spends it. At 6 the charge is the difference-maker: ram him off his Frozen Domain so he cannot kite the all-in.

edits.before: This window flips to Trundle. Once he has two items his R (Subjugate) steals a percent of your resistances AND heals him off your own bulk, while Q-bite keeps sapping the attack damage your W shots rely on — his drain-tank kit is built to grind down exactly the frontloaded stat-checker you are. You can't win a long fight here; he out-sustains you. So close the lane on your 2-3, level-6, and first-item spikes, then use R to engage and roam for your team rather than soloing a fully-itemized Trundle.
edits.after: This window flips to Trundle. Once he has two items Subjugate steals a percent of your health and BOTH resistances and doubles it over four seconds, while Frozen Domain raises every heal he takes and King's Tribute tops him off on each dying minion — so armour and MR are not the answer here, Grievous Wounds is. You cannot win a long fight. Close the lane on your 2-3, level-6 and first-item spikes, then use R to engage and roam rather than soloing a finished Trundle.
